label: team_0130_cassiopeia_01
text: Heh. This must be quite a shock for you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_02
text: The big boss... Cassiopeia... They were both me\nall along.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_03
text: When I saw you make quick work of those Team\nStar lackeys outside school that time, the idea\r\nfor Operation Starfall suddenly came to me.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_04
text: My skills let me get hold of as much LP as I want,\nso I decided to use that to tempt you into\r\nhelping me out.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_05
text: After the operation started, I kept an eye on you\nas a member of the “supply unit”...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_06
text: And I had you battle the bosses on my behalf.\c\nAll for the goal of defeating me and putting an\nend to Team Star once and for all.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_07
text: But still...there’s a part of me that wants Team\nStar to live on! I can’t just roll over and let you\r\nwin without putting up a fight![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_08
text: This is the final showdown. Are you ready?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_select_01
text: I’m ready

label: team_0130_select_02
text: Not just yet

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_09
text: All right. Get yourself sorted, then we’ll try\nthis again.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_10
text: Thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_nelke_01
text: Sorry to keep you.\c\nThe letter of apology Ms. Tyme had me— Errr...\nI mean, preparations took longer than expected.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_11
text: That voice... Are you Clive?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_nelke_03
text: Penny. So it was you after— Ah. No, I mean...\nIs that you, Cassiopeia?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_12
text: In the flesh. I’ve a task for you, Clive, if you’ll\naccept it.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_13
text: I want you to record what happens next so I can\nsend the video to Team Star. They need to see\r\nthe outcome of this battle for themselves.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_nelke_04
text: O-OK... Will do.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_14
text: Then allow me to introduce myself properly...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_15
text: I’m the big boss of Team Star. The name’s\nCassiopeia—[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0130_cassiopeia_17
text: Now, bow down before the overwhelming might\nof Team Star’s founder![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
